keyFindings.description: Quoted or backslash-escaped exact words evade the argument rule although bash passes identical argv (the jj word must be bare; non-bare words are dropped from args). Verified in a scratch repo: the quoted-subcommand forms, the quoted op-subcommand form, the quoted jj word, and the fully backslash-escaped subcommand all performed the rollback; matcher returns undefined for each. Fix: judge every word text regardless of quoting; drop ShellWord.bare (plain-text pass on every word). Thread https://github.com/sjawhar/legion/pull/1020#discussion_r3999453664

Redirection metacharacters and line continuation are not modelled: `>` is not a word terminator (subcommand>/dev/null), `&` inside `>&`/`&>` is taken as a command terminator (2>&1 placed before the subcommand splits the invocation), and backslash-newline is prepended to the next word. Each verified to run the rollback in a scratch repo. Fix: `<`/`>` end a word; `&` adjacent to `>`/`<` ends a word not a command; backslash-newline is dropped. Thread https://github.com/sjawhar/legion/pull/1020#discussion_r3999453666

Usage header does not list --prompt-file for drive/tui (parsed at line 973, documented in README). Non-blocking; fold into the corrective push or fast-follow. Thread https://github.com/sjawhar/legion/pull/1020#discussion_r3999453669
